title: Funerals he played and with which bands
summary: Jiles played funerals with Kid Rene, Chris Kelly, Tuxedo and pickup bands, but never Eureka.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: What about, you mentioned funeral martyrs, did you ever play many funerals?
Funerals? I've played quite a few.

I played Rene, Kid Rene, played one couple with Chris Kelly, played with the Joan, the Tuxedo band. I never did play any with the Eureka. And I played occasionally make-up bands, Kid Howard, and Chic, and different fellas. A band would have just gone down for that day, Kid Howard band, or Kid Chic.
